basis.orthogonality: Continuous uniform arc-length integral S*T=0; both have zero mean. Pixel observations need not stay orthogonal.

encoder.rule: Single normal displacement a1*S+a2*T, then one original binary rasterization; never sequential image warps.
encoder.orientation: Original lexicographic canonical endpoints and normalized arc length; fixed tube mask, exterior unchanged.

receiver.implementation: Exact prior joint S/T receiver, mode=S; bit-blind R0 priority/A3 fallback, unchanged gates.
receiver.limitation: Existing information gate measures S coverage. Joint covariance guards both coefficients. T-specific coverage recorded descriptively, no new gate.

input_admission.rule: First descending-length curve with nine accepted actual raster states in both heads; four distinct marked PNGs; nearest ideal joint sign center recovers all four; minimum coefficient separation>=0.35px.

design.cal_source: Six uniformly sampled prior Fresh24 contents, only new 2-bit PNG used for fitting.
design.eval_source: Twelve uniform COCO normal train contents excluding all currently observable historical IDs.

calibration.features: Observed S/T coefficients minus source clean-input coefficients.
calibration.channel: OLS y=b+A*x on accepted Cal clean, axis and four-word states; actual raster-input x, no Eval fitting.
calibration.classifier: Four predicted actual-input centroids, shared Cal residual covariance Mahalanobis nearest centroid; no expected word in synchronization.
calibration.presence: Cal clean Gaussian vs uniform four-centroid Gaussian mixture; Cal-only residual covariances, clean95% threshold.
calibration.erasure: Geometry/input book unavailable: no word; full-message failure. Presence score=-1e6, rejected.
calibration.finite_difference: Central nominal-axis differences on Cal, plus joint-corner differences and input-domain response; missing pairs excluded with counts.

quality.reference: same prompt/seed clean output; diagnostic source comparison also reported
quality.policy: All marked attempts included; zero-change outputs not accepted as transmission

scope: Four-word modulation prototype; no RS/RM, no logical stitching, no claim that a 2-bit alphabet itself provides error correction.
